source_text: τεῖν, ἐν ᾧ καὶ δι' οὗ θείας φύσεως ἀναδεδείγμεθα κοινωνοὶ, συνείροντος ἡμᾶς εἰς ἑνότητα τοῦ Χριστοῦ· ἔφη γάρ που πρὸς τὸν Πατέρα· «Θέλω ἵνα ὥσπερ ἐγὼ καὶ σὺ ἕν ἐσμεν, οὕτω καὶ αὐτοὶ ἐν ἡμῖν ἒν ὦσιν.» –»Ἒν γὰρ δὴ σῶμα οἱ πάντες ἐσμὲν ἐν Χριστῷ,» καί· «Ὁ κολλώμενος τῷ Κυρίῳ ἓν πνεῦμά ἐστι,» κατὰ τὴν Γραφήν. Ὅτι, δὲ τοῦ Θεοῦ καὶ Πατρὸς τὸ ἴδιον ὥσπερ ἐπαίροντος πρόσωπον, τοῦτ' ἔστι, δοξάζοντος τὸν Υἱὸν, τὴν πρὸς αὐτὸν εἰρήνην πεπλουτήκαμεν, σαφηνιεῖ λέγων αὐτός· «Ὅταν ὑψωθῶ ἐκ τῆς γῆς, πάντας ἑλκύσω πρὸς ἐμαυτόν.» {ΠΑΛΛ.} Ὀρθῶς διανοῇ. «Αὐτὸς γάρ ἐστιν ἡ εἰρήνη ἡμῶν, καὶ δι' αὐτοῦ τὴν προσαγωγὴν ἐσχήκαμεν ἐν πνεύματι πρὸς τὸν Πατέρα.» {ΚΥΡ.} Ἱερέων μὲν οὖν πέρι καὶ τῆς ἐπ' αὐτοῖς ἀναδείξεως ταυτὶ πρὸς ἡμᾶς ὁ νόμος. Ἁγιάζεσθαι δὲ δεῖν εὖ μάλα φησὶ τὸ Λευιτικὸν, καὶ τοῖς καθήκουσι τρόποις προηγνισμένον, τῆς ἐκνεμηθείσης αὐτοῖς λειτουργίας μεταποιεῖσθαι τότε. Λέγει δὲ οὕτως ἐν τοῖς Ἀριθμοῖς· «Λάβε τοὺς Λευίτας ἐκ μέσου τῶν υἱῶν Ἰσραὴλ, καὶ ἀφαγνιεῖς αὐτοὺς, καὶ οὕτως ποιήσεις τὸν ἀφαγνισμὸν αὐτῶν· περιῤῥανεῖς αὐτοὺς ὕδωρ ἁγνισμοῦ, καὶ ἐπελεύσεται ξυρὸν ἐπὶ πᾶν τὸ σῶμα αὐτῶν, καὶ πλυνοῦσι τὰ ἱμάτια αὐτῶν, καὶ καθαροὶ ἔσονται, καὶ λήψονται μόσχον ἕνα ἐκ βοῶν, καὶ τούτου θυσίαν σεμίδαλιν ἀναπεποιημένην ἐν ἐλαίῳ, καὶ μόσχον ἕνα ἐνιαύσιον ἐκ βοῶν λήψῃ περὶ ἁμαρτίας, καὶ προσάξεις τοὺς Λευίτας ἔνδοσθεν τῆς σκηνῆς τοῦ μαρτυρίου. Καὶ συνάξεις πᾶσαν συναγωγὴν υἱῶν Ἰσραὴλ, καὶ προσάξεις τοὺς Λευίτας, καὶ ἀφορίσει Ἀαρὼν τοὺς Λευίτας, ἀπόδομα ἔναντι Κυρίου παρὰ τῶν υἱῶν Ἰσραὴλ, καὶ ἔσονται ὥστε ἐργάζεσθαι τὰ ἔργα Κυρίου. Οἱ δὲ Λευῖται ἐπιθήσουσι τὰς χεῖρας ἐπὶ τὰς κεφαλὰς τῶν μόσχων, καὶ ποιήσεις τὸν ἕνα περὶ ἁμαρτίας, καὶ τὸν ἕνα εἰς ὁλοκαύτωμα, καὶ ἐξιλάσασθαι περὶ αὐτῶν. Καὶ στήσεις τοὺς Λευίτας ἔναντι Κυρίου, καὶ ἐναντίον. Ἀαρὼν, καὶ ἐναντίον τῶν υἱῶν αὐτοῦ, καὶ ἀποδώσεις αὐτοὺς, ἀπόδομα ἔναντι Κυρίου, καὶ διαστελεῖς τοὺς Λευίτας ἐκ μέσου τῶν υἱῶν Ἰσραὴλ, καὶ ἔσονται ἐμοὶ, καὶ μετὰ ταῦτα εἰσελεύσονται οἱ Λευῖται ἐργάζεσθαι τὰ ἔργα τῆς σκηνῆς τοῦ μαρτυρίου.» {ΠΑΛΛ.} Διασάφει δὴ οὖν εὖ μάλα, τίς ἂν νοοῖτο πρὸς ἡμῶν ὁ τοῦ ἁγνισμοῦ τρόπος, τοῦ τοῖς Λευίταις ἐπενηνεγμένου. {ΚΥΡ.} Μυστικὸς μὲν οὖν, ὦ Παλλάδιε, καὶ ἐν Χριστῷ δὴ πάλιν· αὐτὸς γὰρ ἡμῶν ἡ ἀποκάθαρσις, καὶ ῥύπου παντὸς ἡ ἀπόνιψις, καὶ ἁγιασμοῦ δοτήρ. Περιῤῥανεῖς γὰρ αὐτοὺς ὕδωρ ἁγνισμοῦ, φησί. Τοῦτό τοι καὶ ὁ σοφὸς κατεδήλου Παῦλος, ὡδὶ γεγραφώς· «Εἰ γὰρ τὸ αἷμα τράγων καὶ ταύρων, καὶ σποδὸς δαμάλεως ῥαντίζουσα τοὺς κεκοινωμένους ἁγιάζει πρὸς τὴν τῆς σαρκὸς καθαρότητα, πόσῳ μᾶλλον τὸ αἷμα Χριστοῦ·» καὶ ἀληθὴς ὁ λόγος. Εἰ γὰρ ἔνεστι τοῖς τύποις τὸ ὠφελοῦν, καὶ ἡ σκιὰ σωτήριος, πῶς ἂν οὐχὶ μᾶλλον τὸ ἀληθὲς, τουτέστι, τὸ αἷμα Χριστοῦ· Ὕδωρ δὴ οὖν ἁγνισμοῦ τὸ ἀναμὶξ τῇ σποδῷ τῆς δαμάλεως τῆς λεγομένης νεκρώσεως τοῦ Χριστοῦ σύμ
pass_a_gloss: [περιπα]τεῖν — [to walk in Spirit], in whom and through whom (ἐν ᾧ καὶ δι' οὗ) we have been shown (ἀναδεδείγμεθα) sharers (κοινωνοί) of divine nature (θείας φύσεως), Christ stringing us together (συνείροντος) into unity (ἑνότης); for he said to the Father: 'I will (θέλω) that as I and you are one, so they also may be one in us' [John 17:21-22, with θέλω as 17:24]. For one body (σῶμα) we all are in Christ [Rom 12:5], and 'the one cleaving (κολλώμενος) to the Lord is one spirit' [1 Cor 6:17], according to Scripture. That, God and Father as it were lifting up (ἐπαίροντος) his own face — that is, glorifying (δοξάζοντος) the Son — we have been enriched (πεπλουτήκαμεν) with the peace toward him (τὴν πρὸς αὐτὸν εἰρήνην), he himself will make clear (σαφηνιεῖ) saying: 'When I am lifted up (ὑψωθῶ) from the earth, I will draw (ἑλκύσω) all to myself' [John 12:32]. PALL.: You think rightly (ὀρθῶς διανοῇ). 'For he is our peace' [Eph 2:14], 'and through him we have had the access (προσαγωγή) in spirit to the Father' [Eph 2:18 / Rom 5:2 ἐσχήκαμεν]. CYR.: About priests and their appointment (ἀνάδειξις), these things the law [says] to us. It says the Levitical [body] (τὸ Λευιτικόν) must be well sanctified (ἁγιάζεσθαι), and having been pre-purified (προηγνισμένον) in the fitting ways, then lay claim to (μεταποιεῖσθαι) the ministry (λειτουργία) allotted (ἐκνεμηθείσης) to them. It says thus in Numbers: Num 8:6-15 LXX — take the Levites from the midst of the sons of Israel and purify (ἀφαγνιεῖς) them; thus you shall do their purification (ἀφαγνισμός): sprinkle (περιρρανεῖς) them water of purification (ὕδωρ ἁγνισμοῦ), a razor (ξυρόν) shall come over their whole body, they shall wash (πλυνοῦσι) their garments (ἱμάτια), they shall be clean (καθαροί); they shall take one calf (μόσχος) from cattle and its sacrifice, fine flour (σεμίδαλις) mixed (ἀναπεποιημένην) in oil, and one yearling calf you shall take for sin (περὶ ἁμαρτίας); bring the Levites within (ἔνδοσθεν) the tent of witness (σκηνὴ τοῦ μαρτυρίου); gather all the assembly (συναγωγή); bring forward the Levites; Aaron shall separate (ἀφορίσει) the Levites, a gift-rendered (ἀπόδομα) before the Lord from the sons of Israel, and they shall be to work the works of the Lord; the Levites lay their hands on the heads of the calves; you shall make one for sin and one for whole burnt offering (ὁλοκαύτωμα), and to make propitiation (ἐξιλάσασθαι) for them; stand the Levites before the Lord, before Aaron and his sons, and render them an ἀπόδομα before the Lord; distinguish (διαστελεῖς) the Levites from the sons of Israel, they shall be mine; after this the Levites shall enter to work the works of the tent of witness. PALL.: Clarify well how the manner (τρόπος) of purification (ἁγνισμός) brought upon the Levites would be understood by us. CYR.: Mystical (μυστικός), Palladius, and in Christ again; for he is our cleansing (ἀποκάθαρσις), the washing-off (ἀπόνιψις) of all filth (ῥύπος), giver (δοτήρ) of sanctification (ἁγιασμός). For 'you shall sprinkle them water of purification,' it says. This the wise Paul showed, writing: Heb 9:13-14 (if the blood of goats and bulls and ash (σποδός) of a heifer (δάμαλις) sprinkling (ῥαντίζουσα) the defiled (κεκοινωμένους) sanctifies toward the purity (καθαρότης) of the flesh, how much more the blood of Christ). And the word is true. For if benefit (τὸ ὠφελοῦν) is in the types (τύποι), and the shadow (σκιά) is saving (σωτήριος), how not rather the truth (τὸ ἀληθές), that is, the blood of Christ? The water of purification, then, mixed (ἀναμίξ) with the ash of the heifer, of the so-called putting-to-death/dying (νέκρωσις) of Christ a sym[bol] — [word split into §27: σύμ|βολον ἐναργὲς ἦν, 'was a clear symbol'].
pass_b_english: Cyril: …in whom and through whom we have been shown to be sharers in the divine nature (2 Peter 1:4), since Christ binds us together into unity. For he said somewhere to the Father: ‘I desire that, just as you and I are one, so they too may be one in us’ (John 17:21–22). For, as Scripture says, ‘we are all one body in Christ’ (Romans 12:5), and ‘whoever is joined to the Lord is one spirit’ (1 Corinthians 6:17). And that we have been enriched with peace toward him when God the Father, as it were, lifted up his own face, that is, glorified the Son, he himself will make plain when he says: ‘When I am lifted up from the earth, I will draw all people to myself’ (John 12:32).
Palladius: You think rightly. ‘For he is our peace’ (Ephesians 2:14), ‘and through him we have gained access in the Spirit to the Father’ (Ephesians 2:18).

Cyril: This, then, is what the law tells us about the priests and how they were appointed. It also says that the Levites must be thoroughly sanctified, and only then, once purified beforehand in the proper ways, take up the ministry assigned to them. In Numbers it says this: ‘Take the Levites from among the children of Israel, and purify them. And this is how you shall perform their purification: you shall sprinkle them with water of purification, and a razor shall pass over their whole body, and they shall wash their garments, and they shall be clean. And they shall take one young bull from the herd, and with it its sacrifice of fine flour mixed with oil; and you shall take one young bull a year old from the herd for a sin offering. And you shall bring the Levites inside the tabernacle of testimony. And you shall gather the whole congregation of the children of Israel, and you shall bring the Levites forward, and Aaron shall set the Levites apart as an offering before the Lord from the children of Israel, so that they may do the works of the Lord. And the Levites shall lay their hands on the heads of the bulls, and you shall offer the one as a sin offering and the other as a whole burnt offering, to make atonement for them. And you shall set the Levites before the Lord, and before Aaron, and before his sons, and you shall give them over as an offering before the Lord. And you shall separate the Levites from among the children of Israel, and they shall be mine. And after this the Levites shall go in to do the works of the tabernacle of testimony’ (Numbers 8:6–15).
Palladius: Explain clearly, then, how we should understand the manner of purification applied to the Levites.

Cyril: It is a mystical one, Palladius, and once again it is in Christ. For he is our cleansing, the washing away of every stain, and the giver of sanctification. ‘For you shall sprinkle them,’ it says, ‘with water of purification’ (Numbers 8:7). This is just what the wise Paul made plain when he wrote: ‘For if the blood of goats and bulls, and the ashes of a heifer sprinkled on those who have been defiled, sanctify for the purity of the flesh, how much more the blood of Christ’ (Hebrews 9:13–14). And the saying is true. For if there is benefit in the types, and the shadow brings salvation, how could the truth, that is, the blood of Christ, not do so far more? So the water of purification, mixed with the ashes of the heifer (Numbers 19:9, 17), was a clear symbol of what is called the dying of Christ…
